work_item: B04 ordinary CLI CSV/JSON exact-row filtering and stable sorting follow-up; CSV sort span-label correction
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: Supplied table rows -> sealed input -> unique Core -> exact-string filtered/stably sorted results, complete source evidence and durable typed stops
three_document_set: N/A; no construction three-document set specified
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

pre_correction_observation.production_source: Base commit with newly added normal-route assertions before production edits.
pre_correction_observation.observed_result: The first Japanese ascending CSV sort reached COMMIT/COMPUTED and passed table value/order, render, dependency and durable inspection checks, but its actual dependency carried CSV_FILTER_HEADER instead of the expected sort header label. The remaining variants in that CSV sort test were not reached. The CSV filter pipeline, JSON filter/sort and typed-stop tests passed.
pre_correction_observation.cause: The shared named_rows_as_json serializer hardcoded CSV_FILTER_HEADER/CELL for both CSV_FILTER and CSV_SORT operations.

correction: Derive HEADER/CELL span kinds from the existing operation value. CSV filtering retains CSV_FILTER_*; new CSV sorting artifacts use CSV_SORT_*. Input grammar, parser version, record field shape and displayed table bytes are unchanged. New sort artifact bytes/hashes reflect the corrected labels; existing stored blobs are not rewritten.

resolved_check_failure.reason: The new test oracle sliced a string and then called as_bytes; Clippy required slicing the byte view instead.
resolved_check_failure.correction: Use &source.as_bytes()[start..end]; no assertion or lint threshold was relaxed. The final same-scope lint/check/test commands passed.

tests_and_route.route_method: Tests launch minidora-rust with --json and fresh real stores, read actual returned CSV DocumentResult/JSON report dependencies with actor/case-checked Store::get_bytes, and inspect original requests and complete results in fresh CLI processes. No action or result is synthesized.
tests_and_route.full_workspace_tests: NOT_RUN; bounded source-span metadata correction and the four affected normal row-operation routes were covered with document component tests and workspace all-target compile/lint. Input grammar is unchanged; prior input/full-suite observations belong to their separately recorded snapshots.

route_observations.evidence: All six CSV predicate source spans, three headers and all selected cells are covered by an exact unique span tuple set. Original CSV source positions and emitted output row/column positions are checked; rejected rows retain predicate spans. CSV stores predicate values and equals parameters, not an explicit matched boolean.
route_observations.downstream: The actual strict columns/rows CSV-filter output is supplied as the next explicit CLI input. Ascending JSON-sort indices are [1,0,2] within that intermediate table, or [] for zero rows. The intermediate source hash/ranges are checked; no automatic original-CSV provenance composition is claimed.

route_observations.evidence: String order distinguishes 01,10,2. Ties retain original row order in both directions. All 21 unique sort header/cell span tuples have exact original and output row/column offsets, including repeated values; corrected CSV_SORT_* kinds are required.

Every header and emitted cell range/hash is checked against its original source row/column. Filtering checks all six explicit decisions, including value, matched flag, source index and source span for rejected rows. Raw escaped id/open lexemes remain distinct original byte ranges while decoded strings drive equality and ordering.

render_and_persistence_evidence: All positive cases check COMMIT/COMPUTED, RENDERED, actual text/render hashes, content-plan text equality, one actor/case-authorized dependency, original request/body and complete result in a separate inspect process.
report_boundary: JSON filter/sort result.text is a metadata-bearing report, not a strict two-field table. This follow-up directly feeds only the strict CSV-filter output to JSON-sort; later reuse of a JSON report requires an explicit table projection. No implicit report-to-table adaptation was added.

retained_local_evidence.remote_storage_verification: NOT_RUN; local diagnostic-state/log retention only, no OneDrive storage claim

known_limits: These authored cases are scoped QC, not an independent held-out B04 acceptance population.

Historical sort blobs retain old labels. No in-repository consumer requiring old CSV_FILTER_* sort labels was found; external consumer compatibility is unobserved. No automatic historical-record migration or exact-retry migration was performed.

Header-only direct inputs, other sort/equality semantics, broader transformations, full workspace runtime regression, external LIVE evaluation, Windows/macOS, physical 8 GB QA, release and deployment are NOT_RUN.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; selected row filter/sort routes, actual-output consumption and typed stops observed, not the complete B04 contract
